name: Shimmering Drachma #6
description:
A single drachma-like coin exhibiting an unnatural luminescence, contained in a velvet pouch. The coin displays various historical periods upon exposure to air, providing an unusual chemical composition. Handling it promotes feelings of prosperity, with no adverse effects.

EFFECT: Upon holding, induces a temporary sense of prosperity and well-being.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: The coin emits a constant shimmer visible in complete darkness. Upon exposure to air, the surface temporarily transforms, displaying different historical epochs from ancient Greece.
TASTE: Metallic, with a hint of olive oil if licked.
PACKAGING: A small velvet pouch containing a single coin with intricate, shimmering engravings.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-06-21 — edition #6 of the permanent record.
